summary: Verified the Customer Type filter fix on /reports/sales as master admin. Opened the sales-filter-customer-type-panel, iterated through ALL 6 options (Corporate, Drivers, Facility Management, Guest, Housekeeping, Security), toggled each on and off. No blank screen, no React crash (no pageerror), sales-filter-panel remained rendered throughout. Deselect worked. Apply with a customer type selected returned 200 and 'Sales by Customer Type' table (sales-by-customer-type) rendered. Regression: Client/City/Site/Vendor filter triggers still open the main panel without crash. Mobile viewport (390x844) also verified — panel opens, options render, selection keeps app rendered. Only console errors observed were 4 unrelated 401s from initial anonymous requests before login; no pageerror events; no MultiSelect 'Cannot read properties of undefined' error.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix in SalesReport.js (adding customer_types: data.customer_types || []) plus MultiSelect defaults (options=[], selected=[]) is correct and defensive; recommend applying the same defensive default pattern to any other MultiSelect consumer to prevent recurrence.
seed_data_creation: None (default customer types auto-seeded by backend)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sales Report customer type filter fix is verified on desktop (1920x900) and mobile (390x844). All 6 default types selectable individually and via Apply, sales-by-customer-type table renders. No further action needed on this bug.
rca of the issue: Root cause was already fixed by main agent: setCatalog in SalesReport.js omitted customer_types, making catalog.customer_types undefined; MultiSelect then read .length on undefined and crashed the tree. Fix adds customer_types default and MultiSelect gained default props (options=[], selected=[]). Verified — crash no longer reproducible.
